scope: retrospective small-prefix explore, A24 assumed whole-device W/AP, no device validation
selection: first chronological 2/3 tickets of the frozen 24-ticket evaluation trace, not favorable requests; three load regimes and pre-existing distinct power/AP stress profiles
queue_rule: existing THERMAL_ENERGY_PC_V1 aged EDF head; no request reordering by oracle
actions: available CPU/GPU for head or WAIT 250ms while head age <500ms and before deadline; actual arrivals and lane releases remain continuous-time events
question_a: every planned request response no worse than comparator, no extra miss/failure/unfinished; lower common-window J or AP peak
question_b: same completion and no additional deadline miss; per-request response loss bounded by research-only delta
interpretation: offline planner uses future arrivals and realized costs, unlike online policies; complete is only over listed discrete actions and cases
